HISTORICAL (superseded by the 2026-11-05 MODEL REVIEW below where they conflict): Entry symbol confirmed: ros_gazebo_gym.task_envs.panda.panda_reach:PandaReachEnv is defined at src/ros_gazebo_gym/task_envs/panda/panda_reach.py:187 and registered as PandaReach-v1 with max_steps 500 at src/ros_gazebo_gym/task_envs/task_envs_list.py:21-24. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver is the right shape (the primary interface is the gymnasium env step/reset, not the repository's ROS topics), so there is no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD. Backends: fake=.fake:FakePandaReachEnv (the only backend the gate or this package ran) and sim=.fake:make_upstream_env, which imports the installed ros_gazebo_gym package, registers PandaReach-v1 and calls gymnasium.make; the sim path was not run because it needs ROS, Gazebo, MoveIt and the panda_gazebo/panda_moveit_planner_server packages in a catkin workspace. No hardware was attached, and the family has no hardware backend. The fake is an F0 analytic stand-in, not a recording and not the upstream simulator: it reproduces the shipped interface (Box(7) effort action space, Dict observation of observation/desired_goal/achieved_goal, dense distance reward, two hold samples, 500-step time limit) but has no arm, controller, contact or sensor dynamics; its first three effort components move a 3-D end-effector position by a placeholder 0.02 m/unit map and the other four are ignored. The action space copies the upstream space exactly, so action_space_ref cites src/ros_gazebo_gym/task_envs/panda/config/panda_reach.yaml:211-226; because the shipped config sets load_gripper False, the fake's observation member is the three end-effector coordinates (the same size the deployed no-gripper upstream observation has, not a reduced array). A seed repeats a fake episode but not an upstream one: the fake uses random.Random, upstream samples the goal from numpy's generator and the initial pose through MoveIt. NOT COVERED: live Gazebo/MoveIt execution, arm/contact/controller dynamics, controller waits, collisions, the gripper, rendering, and agreement of the fake's trajectories with upstream. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only arms the next reset, so it makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived seed, ticks and action.values inputs; there are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Safety: simulated R0 (isolated simulation stepping), no native stop; the e-stop is the runtime's latching software control, which refuses new step/reset/seed calls and cancels between ticks, but an in-flight native step()/reset() already inside Gazebo or MoveIt is not interrupted, and the upstream close() calls [...]

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6, a model and not a human, 2026-11-02; reviewed_by stays null): FIX and keep native integration BLOCKED. The concrete PandaReach entry and seven source-configured effort bounds are valid, but the original enabled sim factory could launch dependencies, shut down global ROS and propagate SystemExit. Stock controlled-native probes also report a successful software-only stop while the native step remains unpaused; current server correctly refuses reset during that worker, so no reset bypass is claimed. Upstream does expose gazebo.pause_sim, which must be integrated through an owned isolated lifecycle with bounded independent pause and retained pending work. Sim construction and fidelity projection now refuse before imports; fake never substitutes for sim. Reset intentionally preserves the source target-hold counter, so repeated identical seeded first actions can terminate differently; fidelity is now none/partial. Fourteen non-gate cases and the fresh full G1-G9 fake gate pass, but they do not complete native integration. Corrected two source Facts and false no-pause prose. Changed driver.py, fake.py, facts.md, test_driver.py, reference.json, REFERENCE.md, check-report.json and RESULT.json. DeepSeek attribution, pin and null human signature preserved; no real ROS, simulator or hardware was run.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): PASS after repair; the blocked text above is historical and superseded. Depends on the SDK change SIM-HOST (isolated_process_v1, MHS/changes/SIM-HOST.md), still to be reviewed by Claude Sonnet. Both backends run in an isolated simulator host: a child process the endpoint owns imports .fake:FakePandaReachEnv or the new host.py (gymnasium.make PandaReach-v1) on its main thread and contains the upstream exits (ros_exit_gracefully, helpers.py:325-339; in close, pause_sim, _set_action and construction). E-stop: latch, host fence, gazebo.pause_proxy (/gazebo/pause_physics, gazebo_connection.py:50, 136-148); a step in flight is awaited and the pause re-sent, because a step unpauses first (robot_gazebo_goal_env.py:157-163); confirmed only when get_physics_properties().pause is True (:562-580). pause_sim is not used: it retries, then exits, and returns unpaused after a ROS shutdown (:328-356). A dead, unresponsive or non-confirming host is SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED. Risk raised R0 -> R2 (REVIEW.md item 12): direct control publishes the joint efforts on panda_arm_joint_effort_controller/command (panda_reach.yaml:7, panda_env.py:100, 643-657). Disclosed: the stored effort command acts when the next step unpauses; other clients or the GUI can unpause; construction can clone and fetch (network) and asks before sudo rosdep; the pause semantics are gazebo_ros's, outside the clone (gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp pausePhysics and getPhysicsProperties at the corpus pin cd9cc952). Changed driver.py, fake.py (pause model, two test switches, make_upstream_env removed), new host.py, test_driver.py (17 cases, check_driver kept), facts.md, driver.lock.json (backends), reference.json, REFERENCE.md, check-report.json, RESULT.json. Source pin, DeepSeek attribution and null reviewed_by unchanged. G1-G9 pass with the earlier warnings (digest unchanged), contract_checked; no ROS, Gazebo, MoveIt or hardware ran.
